book.name: 1 Peter
book.title: Ka Peter Mu Tunaka'oedyukudu-matoo Mooe Tubona

content: Mu momoko'ne koomamu-ga'yoo sakwa tu koomamu nakabetsea. Tooe gi ka mu koomamu tunaka'oedyukute sapa, umu-matoo tunaka'oedyuku manekwu, ka mumme momoko'ne ooonnekoo, tooe gi hayoo mu unakwe sapa.
Umu oo sopedakwadookwu mu Te Naa doodooamu umu ka mu poonnena, mumme mane-makoo, mu ka Te Naa besa podo meadu.
Mu sakwa gi muusoo unu besa namabetseapana, mu tzopuhu mabetsabena, tooetoo unu nanenagadu-wi namasooana. Mu sakwa besa tabua ka gi nidyapuna, besa'yoona.
Mu ka besa'yoona, mu unu nanenagadu besa tabuadu namasooape-kwa'ne'yoo. Esoo punno'o gi kadoo'oo namayugwe-wa'ne'yoo. Ooonnekoo soo Te Naa besa sooyugwe.
Ka o'nosoo Te Naa doodooamu mu momoko'ne ka Te Naa-wi tunaka'oedyukuna besa namabetzape, yise pummesoo koomamu nakabetse'a.
Soo Sarah mee naneadu puu uga ooonne'yoo, oosoo ka tu kooma Abraham nakabetse'a. Mu oo-wa'ne'yookwu, mu ka besa manena gi no'okosoo hemma suda soonammekuna.

Mu nanana nonodukwamu-ga'yoo sakwa oo sopedakwadoo mu nodukwamu gi mu-kwa'ne nanatzooe. Mu sakwa besa'yoo mee mu sooyukwe umu ka mu natummatzina soogwina, besa nanamatuguna ka nanapa nobe-gana. Soo Te Naa yise ka pumme mu nanetzakwiya'e mu nakasootuhikwu, ka yoo mu manakwe.

Mu tunaka'oedyukudu sakwa no'yoona nanakwa'nesoo unnena, tusooyugwena, ka mu pupua'amu suda sokwama mu punno'o sakwa tutuha mu soobedya, unu nanasoobedyana nanasamoomu-kwa'ne, besa nanamatuguna, mu sakwa gi meeoo tusooyugwepana, “Numme numu ooonakwa besa'yoo,” mee.

Mu sakwa gi numu nesootzemapana, tooe mumme mu nesootzema sapa. Tamme sakwa mu numu tamme wohonedu nanesootuhiku, soo Te Naa meeoo te netamma. Tamme ka mu numu nanesootuhikuna, soo Te Naa tamme sootuhikwu.
Tamme oo sopedakwadoo oosoo ka mee'e nabotuguna.

content.text: “Tamme ka gi suda apegeana, gi tunesootzemana, tamme wuna'metoo momokwu, te sokwama-kwa'nesoo.
Tamme sakwa kaaheno meadabe, yise ka suda te ma'nawena tzadyooiku. Tamme sakwa ooosapa nanano tuunoyugwe.
Soo Te Naa oo sopedakwadoo ka numu besa manakwe, oosoo yise ka putamme mu nanesootuhina nekwekakwu. Pana soo Te Naa ka mu suda tumatugudu numu tumoo'ookwu.”

content: Gi haga te manayaha-wa'ne'yoo tamme ka kaaheno tubetse tusooyugwena.

Soo Te Naa te sootuhikwu ka mu numu tamme tumoo'oo, tamme yise kaaheno meadabekwu. Tamme sakwa ooosapa ka Te Pabe'e nakabetseana oo-matoo nanesootuhi. Tamme sakwa gi mu numu-ma suipana, tamme nekusekadu gi suda oo soonammekupana ka tooe how tooe tamme mu yugwesapa. Tamme sakwa ooosapa besa ka mu numu tuukwe ka Te Pabe'e-witu, ka ooka mu soonaka, tamme ka Te Pabe'e naka'oedyukuna.
Tamme oo sopedakwatoo ka toge manena. O'no sumuna umu ka Te Pabe'e-koobatoo te nekusekadu nasookwikwu. Umu sumuna nasookwina te tumoo'ookwu ka toge te manakwe.
Ka Te Naa meeoo unakwe oosoo besa ka te nanekuseka ka toge te manakwe. Tamme ka ma'emukwase, mu numu sakwa te tumoo'oo. Oosoo gi besa, tamme suda manena.

Soo Te Naa te ma'emukwana soomu'wakwu, o'no tamme yise oo doodooamu manekwu, soo Te Pabe'e ka tamme-koobatoo nabatsase. Tooe soo Te Pabe'e ooosapa ka Te Naa nakabetseapana, oosoo tamme tuma'emukwa-koobatoo nabatsapu. Ka Te Pabe'e nabatsase, oo tookoo suu'mu ya'e oo moogooa gi ya'e.
Soo Te Pabe'e moogooa ka susumudu moogooa nanesootuhibu tunedyoo'e.

Umuoo moogooa ka umu numu gi ka Te Naa nakabetseadu-matu ka Noah tu sake mabetsape, tooe soo Te Naa wuna'me mu wutoo'ese sapa, ka sutakoo po mu ma'wukakwuna. Pana namewatsukwe'yoo (8) numu namagwetzoi, o'no ka baa-makoo, umuoo, o'no ka sake-wi, ka Te Naa ka teepu batatsopakuse.

Ka Noah baa-makoo namagwetzoipu-kwa'nesoo, tamme namagwetzoi tamme ka baa-wi namatzakana. Tamme ka baa-wi namatzakana, tamme namagwetzoi ka Te Naa-matoo nanesootuhina, “Mu besa'yoo,” mee mu te mesoo netamma. Soo Te Naa oo mesoo manakwe, soo Te Pabe'e puu tu ya'e-kwikoo namayoduse, meno'o yise ka Te Naa-baa'yoona no'oko poohabe nemadabue. Gi tamme baa-wi namatzaka ka totsabu te tookoo-makoo sukwe tsabatsugana.
